summary: AMETEK, Inc. filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a Canadian-dollar-denominated offering of senior unsecured notes due in a year left blank in the preliminary filing, with interest payable semiannually beginning 2027. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured senior debt, redeemable in C$1,000 increments, and subject to a 101% change-of-control repurchase offer. Proceeds, together with concurrent securities offerings, will repay borrowings under financing agreements and/or commercial paper used to fund the approximately $5 billion cash acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation, which closed August 26, 2026. Watch pricing and settlement mechanics; the referenced acquisition is already closed and is not itself the event.
